brief.zh: 输出一个数：是 X 就大于 0.6，是 O 就小于 0.4。字母会挪位置、变深浅、带噪点。
brief.en: Output one number: above 0.6 for an X, below 0.4 for an O. The letters move around, vary in strength and carry noise.

hint.zh: 最后的全连接加 Sigmoid 就是<level-ref to="4-5"></level-ref>里那个神经元，把特征变成分数。字母会挪位置、会变深浅，前面要怎样把图变成这样的特征？搭好后按训练。
hint.en: The final dense layer plus sigmoid is the neuron from <level-ref to="4-5"></level-ref>, turning features into a score. The letters move around and vary in strength: how should the parts before it turn the image into such features? Once it is built, press Train.

after.zh: 这是一个最小的卷积网络：卷积找局部笔画，ReLU 把“有”和“没有”分开，池化和全局平均让答案不管字母在哪，全连接加 Sigmoid 把特征变成分数。要是一路全是线性运算（没有 ReLU，也没有最大池化），最后只剩“整张图有多亮”，而淡的 X 和浓的 O 一样亮。
after.en: This is the smallest convolutional network: the convolution finds local strokes, ReLU separates "there" from "not there", pooling and global average make the answer the same wherever the letter is, and the dense layer plus sigmoid turns features into a score. If every operation along the way were linear (no ReLU and no max pooling), all that would be left is "how bright the whole image is", and a faint X is as bright as a strong O.

t.zh: 手写数字识别、拍照认花、相册按人脸分组，问的都是「这是什么」。这类问题叫分类，是视觉里最常见的任务。这一关做最小的一个：只有两类，X 或 O。
t.en: Reading handwritten digits, identifying a flower from a photo, grouping an album by face: they all ask "what is this?". This kind of problem is called classification, the most common task in vision. This level does the smallest one: just two classes, X or O.

t.zh: <level-ref to="4-5"></level-ref>里的神经元拿到的是现成的两个数：斜笔画多少、弯笔画多少。这一关没人替你算，网络只拿到像素，字母还会挪位置、变深浅、带噪点。
t.en: The neuron in <level-ref to="4-5"></level-ref> was handed two ready-made numbers: how many diagonal strokes, how many curved strokes. This time nobody computes them for you. The network gets only pixels, and the letters move around, get lighter or darker, and carry noise.

caption.zh: 一组测试：挪了位置、带噪点的 O
caption.en: One test set: an O that has moved and has noise

t.zh: 手里的元件：<part-ref to="part:lrnConv"></part-ref>是从很小的随机数开始的可学习 3×3 核；<part-ref to="mean"></part-ref>把整张图变成一个数；「全连接」和<part-ref to="sigmoid"></part-ref>是你在前面搭出来的。
t.en: The parts to hand: <part-ref to="part:lrnConv"></part-ref> is a learnable 3×3 kernel that starts from very small random numbers; <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> turns a whole picture into one number; "Dense" and <part-ref to="sigmoid"></part-ref> are what you built earlier.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：输出一个数，X 大于 0.6，O 小于 0.4。要想的问题：X 和 O 到底差在哪里，什么信息该留下？
t.en: Your task: output one number, above 0.6 for X and below 0.4 for O. Something to think about: what really is the difference between X and O, and which information should be kept?
